pmc-11353695.title: Fermented Fish Products: Balancing Tradition and Innovation for Improved Quality
pmc-11353695.creator: Hang Li, Guantian Li, Yunchen Bi, Song Liu, Cristóbal Noé Aguilar González
pmc-11353695.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The flavor profile of fermented fish products is influenced by the complex interplay of microbial and enzymatic actions on the raw materials. This review summarizes the various factors contributing to the unique taste and aroma of these traditional foods. Key ingredients include locally sourced fish species and a variety of spices and seasonings that enhance flavor while serving as cultural markers. Starter cultures also play a critical role in standardizing quality and accelerating fermentation.
